chunks: We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Muhammad ibn Yahya al-‘Attar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from Abu Hashim al-Ja‘fari, that he said: I asked Abu Ja‘far the Second, peace be upon him: What is the meaning of the One?
He said: The One upon which all tongues agree, in Oneness.

key_terms.المجتمع عليه: That upon which it is gathered/agreed

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of 'The One' (Al-Wahid) in Shia theology according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Jawad (AS) defines 'Al-Wahid' not merely as a numerical singularity but as the universal consensus of all tongues in affirming divine Oneness, highlighting the intuitive and linguistic universality of Tawhid. This definition underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the innate recognition of God's unity across all human languages and intellects. It serves as a foundational argument for the clarity and accessibility of the core Islamic creed.
